card.statement:
The affine Yangian associated to the affine algebra of $\ga$ have
been studied by Guay <<cite:Gu>>. We remark that the affine Yangian
for $\gl_1$ should be identified with the $\mc W_{1+\infty}$
algebra. The main result of <<cite:FKRW>> can be reformulated as
follows:

The vertex algebra for the truncated affine Yangian of
$\gl_1$ at level $N$ is isomorphic to the affine $W$-algebra
associated to $\gl_N$ and a regular nilpotent element at level
$N$.
card.label: Remark 71

paper.title: Nilpotent orbits and finite $W$-algebras
paper.abstract: In recent years, the finite W-algebras associated to a semisimple Lie algebra and its nilpotent element have been studied intensively from different viewpoints. In this lecture series, we shall present some basic constructions, connections, and applications of finite W-algebras.
